question_text: Two metal plates A and B are kept horizontally with separation (12/π) cm, with plate A on the top. An atomizer sprays oil droplets (density 1.5 g/cm³) of radius 1 mm horizontally. All oil droplets carry a charge of 5 nC. The potentials V_A and V_B are required on plates A and B respectively in order to ensure the droplets do not fall. Neglect air resistance and take g=10 m/s².
solution: For levitation, qE=ρ(4πr³/3)g. With ρ=1500 kg/m³, r=10⁻³ m and q=5×10⁻⁹ C, E=mg/q=4.0×10⁴ V/m. The plate spacing is 0.12/π m, so the required potential difference magnitude is Ed=480 V. The positive droplets need an upward field, so the lower plate B must be at higher potential: V_A=100 V, V_B=580 V. Option A.

subject: Physics
question_text: Two point charges of 8 μC and −2 μC are located at x=2 cm and x=4 cm, respectively, on the x-axis. The ratio of electric flux due to these charges through two spheres of radii 3 cm and 5 cm, with their centres at the origin, is:
solution: The 3 cm sphere encloses only the +8 μC charge, so its flux is proportional to 8. The 5 cm sphere encloses both charges, giving net enclosed charge 8−2=6 μC. The ratio is 8:6=4:3. Option C.

subject: Physics
question_text: A circular current loop of radius R is placed inside a square loop of side length L (L ≫ R) such that they are coplanar and their centres coincide. The permeability of free space is μ₀. The mutual inductance between the circular loop and square loop is:
solution: By reciprocity, calculate the flux through the small circular loop due to current I in the large square loop. Since L≫R, the field over the circle is approximately the square loop's central field B=2√2 μ₀I/(πL). Thus Φ≈BπR²=2√2 μ₀IR²/L, giving M=Φ/I=2√2 μ₀R²/L. Option D.

subject: Physics
question_text: The binding energy per nucleon of ²⁰⁹₈₃Bi is ____ MeV. Given atomic mass m(²⁰⁹Bi)=208.980388 u, m_p=1.007825 u, m_n=1.008665 u and 1 u=931 MeV/c².
solution: For Z=83 and N=126, mass defect Δm=83(1.007825)+126(1.008665)−208.980388≈1.760877 u. Binding energy per nucleon = Δm×931/209 ≈7.84 MeV. Option B.

subject: Physics
question_text: The equation of motion of a particle is x=a sin(50t+π/3) cm. The particle will come to rest at time t₁ and will have zero acceleration at time t₂. The t₁ and t₂ respectively are:
solution: Velocity is zero when cos(50t+π/3)=0; the first positive time is when the phase is π/2, so t₁=(π/2−π/3)/50=π/300 s. Acceleration is zero when displacement is zero, sin(50t+π/3)=0; the first positive time is when the phase is π, so t₂=(π−π/3)/50=π/75 s. Option A.
